page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.12xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs mapped directly to 48 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. With a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, this instance provides predictable compute performance without hyperthreading overhead.

The instance is configured with 384.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated physical core allocation and high memory density position this instance for workloads requiring consistent compute performance and substantial memory capacity. It is suitable for memory-intensive applications, relational databases, in-memory caching layers, and enterprise applications that benefit from high clock speeds and dedicated CPU resources without thread contention.
